RATIONALE:
Q1: Option A would need someone to paste step durations from run 42426489708, and that data is not in the repository or in GITHUB FACTS. The data-provision guard therefore rules A out, and B is the fallback. Every earlier move in `.github/workflows/ci.yml` was also chosen without readable timings and says so in its comment ("an estimate, not a measurement"), so the new comment must say the step was not measured.
Q2: Moving the step unchanged again would most likely just move the timeout to another group. "Regression tests wired by the CI wiring guard (part 2)" has already gone from group 2 to group 4 (#8772) and then to group 0 (#8980), and each group it landed in was flagged soon after. The comment at `ci.yml` L2679 notes that every other poll group has a recorded total above 15 minutes. The repository has already handled this situation by splitting a step in place: "wiring guard part 1" (#8246, ci.yml L1842-1858) did it after earlier moves kept re-triggering budget-watch elsewhere, and so did #8150, which is closed as completed. This option keeps all of the issue's firm limits: the same job and step names, the same `if: strategy.job-index == 0`, no higher `timeout-minutes`, and no new job names. It changes the step body only to run the same tests across 4 parallel processes, each exactly once. The planner must keep these existing checks in `tests/test_ci_poll_test_sharding.py` passing: `MovedPollGroupTwo8772StepsContractTest` and `MovedPollGroupFour8980StepsContractTest` (L3374-3395, L3577-3589) match every `tests/*.py` path in the body. So all 53 modules must appear exactly once in the step's module array, the module-set sha256 (`e6795c8a...`) must stay the same, and no other `tests/*.py` path can appear in the body. The comment and docstring that say "body unchanged" should be updated to describe the split. The split should get its own contract tests, following `WiringGuardPartOneShardingContractTest`, with new identifiers that do not clash with the part-1 names (for example a `wg2_` prefix instead of `wg1_`).
